assessment: The regulation of cell growth is crucial for our understanding of how cells control their size as well as how they balance cell mass and volume. While recent studies carefully measured single-cell mass trajectories during the cell cycle, revealing complex growth patterns, the volume growth patterns of animal cells are poorly understood. In this interesting study, Cadart et al. now present high-precision measurements of 1700 HeLa cell growth trajectories and offer evidence for the mechanisms that regulate volume growth-rate fluctuations. This is an important demonstration of cell-autonomous volume regulation.
